### Importing Data
### LB stands for Less_Bloat

```{r}
DTS_fulltext <- read_csv("DTS_articles_fulltext.csv")

DTS_fulltext_LB <- DTS_fulltext %>%
  filter(!grepl("M13|WNDRCO", filename))
```

### Validating data
```{r}
DTS_LB_id <- DTS_fulltext_LB |> 
  distinct(id) |> 
  filter(!is.na(id))
```


### Converting published_date to year

```{r}
DTS_fulltext <- DTS_fulltext |> 
  mutate(year = year(published_date))

DTS_fulltext_LB <- DTS_fulltext_LB |> 
  mutate(year = year(published_date))
```

### Process into corpus object

```{r}
textdata <- DTS_fulltext %>% 
  select(filename, sentence, year) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rename(doc_id = filename, text= sentence)

textdata_LB <- DTS_fulltext_LB %>% 
  select(filename, sentence, year) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rename(doc_id = filename, text= sentence)
```

### Remove stopwords, clean corpus

```{r}
# 1. Define standard stopwords
english_stopwords <- stopwords("en")

# 2. Build corpus
corpus <- Corpus(DataframeSource(textdata))
corpus_LB <- Corpus(DataframeSource(textdata_LB))

# 3. Clean in correct sequence
processedCorpus <- tm_map(corpus, content_transformer(tolower))
processedCorpus <- tm_map(processedCorpus, removePunctuation, preserve_intra_word_dashes = TRUE)
processedCorpus <- tm_map(processedCorpus, removeNumbers)

processedCorpus_LB <- tm_map(corpus_LB, content_transformer(tolower))
processedCorpus_LB <- tm_map(processedCorpus_LB, removePunctuation, preserve_intra_word_dashes = TRUE)
processedCorpus_LB <- tm_map(processedCorpus_LB, removeNumbers)

# Remove stopwords BEFORE stemming
processedCorpus <- tm_map(processedCorpus, removeWords, english_stopwords)

processedCorpus_LB <- tm_map(processedCorpus_LB, removeWords, english_stopwords)

# Stem documents after removing stopwords
processedCorpus <- tm_map(processedCorpus, stemDocument, language = "en")
processedCorpus <- tm_map(processedCorpus, stripWhitespace)

processedCorpus_LB <- tm_map(processedCorpus_LB, stemDocument, language = "en")
processedCorpus_LB <- tm_map(processedCorpus_LB, stripWhitespace)
```

```{r tm3a}
#DTM: rows correspond to the documents in the corpus. Columns correspond to the terms in the documents. Cells correspond to the weights of the terms. (Girder)
# compute document term matrix with terms >= minimumFrequency
minimumFrequency <- 5
DTM <- DocumentTermMatrix(processedCorpus, control = list(bounds = list(global = c(minimumFrequency, Inf))))
# have a look at the number of documents and terms in the matrix
dim(DTM)
# due to vocabulary pruning, we have empty rows in our DTM
# LDA does not like this. So we remove those docs from the
# DTM and the metadata
sel_idx <- slam::row_sums(DTM) > 0
DTM <- DTM[sel_idx, ]
textdata <- textdata[sel_idx, ]
#5 term minimum[1] 1387 3019
#5 term minimum[1] 308597 10339

minimumFrequency <- 5
DTM_LB <- DocumentTermMatrix(processedCorpus_LB, control = list(bounds = list(global = c(minimumFrequency, Inf))))

dim(DTM_LB)

sel_idx <- slam::row_sums(DTM_LB) > 0
DTM_LB <- DTM_LB[sel_idx, ]
textdata_LB <- textdata_LB[sel_idx, ]

```

## Topic proportions over time {.unnumbered}

### We examine topics in the data over time by aggregating mean topic proportions per decade. These aggregated topic proportions can then be visualized, e.g. as a bar plot.

```{r}
# append decade information for aggregation
textdata$decade <- paste0(substr(textdata$year, 0, 3), "0")

textdata_LB$decade <- paste0(substr(textdata_LB$year, 0, 3), "0")
```

### Articles per decade

```{r}
#install.packages("formattable")
articles_decades <- textdata %>% 
  distinct(doc_id, .keep_all=TRUE) %>% 
  count(decade) %>% 
  mutate(pct_total= (n/sum(n))) %>% 
  mutate(pct_total= formattable::percent(pct_total)) %>% 
  # mutate(pct_total = round(pct_total, 1)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(decade))

articles_decades_LB <- textdata_LB %>% 
  distinct(doc_id, .keep_all=TRUE) %>% 
  count(decade) %>% 
  mutate(pct_total= (n/sum(n))) %>% 
  mutate(pct_total= formattable::percent(pct_total)) %>% 
  # mutate(pct_total = round(pct_total, 1)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(decade))

library(kableExtra)
articles_decades %>%
  kbl(caption = "DTS Articles by Decade (n=9,589, 10/23/2024)", font_size = 30) %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = F, html_font = "Cambria") %>% 
  column_spec(1, bold = T, border_right = T) %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "5em") %>% 
  column_spec(3, width = "5em", background = "yellow") 

articles_decades_LB %>%
  kbl(caption = "DTS Articles without M13 and WNDRCO by Decade (n=9,589, 10/23/2024)", font_size = 30) %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = F, html_font = "Cambria") %>% 
  column_spec(1, bold = T, border_right = T) %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "5em") %>% 
  column_spec(3, width = "5em", background = "yellow") 



#Fact check 110 articles
#sum(articles_decades$n)
```

```{r tm12}
# number of topics
# K <- 20
K <- 6
# set random number generator seed
set.seed(9161)
#Latent Dirichlet Allocation, LDA
topicModel2 <- LDA(DTM, K, method="Gibbs", control=list(iter = 500, verbose = 25, alpha = 0.2))
tmResult <- posterior(topicModel2)
theta <- tmResult$topics
beta <- tmResult$terms
topicNames <- apply(terms(topicModel2, 10), 2, paste, collapse = " ")  # reset topicnames

topicModel2_LB <- LDA(DTM_LB, K, method="Gibbs", control=list(iter = 500, verbose = 25, alpha = 0.2))
tmResult_LB <- posterior(topicModel2_LB)
theta_LB <- tmResult_LB$topics
beta_LB <- tmResult_LB$terms
topicNames_LB <- apply(terms(topicModel2_LB, 10), 2, paste, collapse = " ")  # reset topicnames_LB
```

### Mean topic proportions per decade

```{r}
# Step 1: Check dimensions
n_theta <- nrow(theta)
n_theta_LB <- nrow(theta_LB)
n_textdata <- length(textdata$decade)
n_textdata_LB <- length(textdata_LB$decade)

cat("Number of rows in theta: ", n_theta, "\n")
cat("Number of rows in theta_LB: ", n_theta_LB, "\n")
cat("Number of documents in textdata: ", n_textdata, "\n")
cat("Number of documents in textdata_LB: ", n_textdata_LB, "\n")

# Check if textdata contains all the documents in theta
common_ids <- intersect(rownames(theta), textdata$doc_id) # Assuming textdata has a 'doc_id' column

common_ids_LB <- intersect(rownames(theta_LB), textdata_LB$doc_id)

# Filter textdata to include only the documents present in theta
textdata_filtered <- textdata[textdata$doc_id %in% common_ids, ]
textdata_filtered_LB <- textdata_LB[textdata_LB$doc_id %in% common_ids_LB, ]

# Check dimensions after filtering
n_textdata_filtered <- nrow(textdata_filtered)
cat("Number of documents in filtered textdata: ", n_textdata_filtered, "\n")

n_textdata_filtered_LB <- nrow(textdata_filtered_LB)
cat("Number of documents in filtered textdata_LB: ", n_textdata_filtered_LB, "\n")

cat("Num in n_theta: ", n_theta, "\n")
cat("Num in n_theta: ", n_theta_LB, "\n")

# Ensure the lengths match now
if (n_theta != n_textdata_filtered) {
  stop("The number of rows in 'theta' still does not match the length of 'textdata_filtered$decade'.")
}

if (n_theta_LB != n_textdata_filtered_LB) {
  stop("The number of rows in 'theta_LB' still does not match the length of 'textdata_filtered_LB$decade'.")
}

# Align rownames of theta with filtered textdata
theta_aligned <- theta[rownames(theta) %in% textdata_filtered$doc_id, ]
theta_aligned_LB <- theta_LB[rownames(theta_LB) %in% textdata_filtered_LB$doc_id, ]

# Optional: Verify the order of documents
if (!all(rownames(theta_aligned) == textdata_filtered$doc_id)) {
  # If the order doesn't match, reorder one to match the other
  textdata_filtered <- textdata_filtered[match(rownames(theta_aligned), textdata_filtered$doc_id), ]
}

if (!all(rownames(theta_aligned_LB) == textdata_filtered_LB$doc_id)) {
  # If the order doesn't match, reorder one to match the other
  textdata_filtered_LB <- textdata_filtered_LB[match(rownames(theta_aligned_LB), textdata_filtered_LB$doc_id), ]
}

# Ensure they are now aligned and can be combined
if (!all(rownames(theta_aligned) == textdata_filtered$doc_id)) {
  stop("The document IDs still do not match. Please check the data alignment.")
}

if (!all(rownames(theta_aligned_LB) == textdata_filtered_LB$doc_id)) {
  stop("The document IDs still do not match. Please check the data alignment.")
}

# Step 2: Combine data
topic_data <- data.frame(theta_aligned, decade = textdata_filtered$decade)
topic_data_LB <- data.frame(theta_aligned_LB, decade = textdata_filtered_LB$decade)

# Step 3: Aggregate data
topic_proportion_per_decade <- aggregate(. ~ decade, data = topic_data, FUN = mean)
topic_proportion_per_decade_LB <- aggregate(. ~ decade, data = topic_data_LB, FUN = mean)


# get mean topic proportions per decade
# topic_proportion_per_decade <- aggregate(theta, by = list(decade = textdata$decade), mean)
# set topic names to aggregated columns
colnames(topic_proportion_per_decade)[2:(K+1)] <- topicNames
colnames(topic_proportion_per_decade_LB)[2:(K+1)] <- topicNames_LB
# reshape data frame
vizDataFrame <- melt(topic_proportion_per_decade, id.vars = "decade")
vizDataFrame_LB <- melt(topic_proportion_per_decade_LB, id.vars = "decade")

# #filter out 1960 - one article
vizDataFrame <- vizDataFrame %>% 
   filter(!decade==1960)
```

#Examine topic names

```{r}
#enframe(): Converts a named list into a dataframe.
topics <- enframe(topicNames, name = "number", value = "text") %>% 
  unnest(cols = c(text)) 

topics_LB <- enframe(topicNames_LB, name = "number", value = "text") %>% 
  unnest(cols = c(text)) 
  
topics
topics_LB
```

### Review the topics and determine a 1-2 word label after reading the source documents.

```{r}

#Topic 1	lightspe market fund class million share june firm compani startup

theta2 <- as.data.frame(theta)

topic1 <- theta2 %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "file") |> # putting the rownames into a new column called file
  mutate(file = str_remove(file, "^X"),  # Remove leading 'X'
         line = str_extract(file, "(?<=\\.txt)\\.\\d+")) |>   # Extract number after .txt
  mutate(file = str_remove(file, "\\.\\d+$")) |> 
  rename(topic1 = '1') |> # looking at first topic: lightspe market fund class million share june firm compani startup
  top_n(20, topic1) |> 
  arrange(desc(topic1)) |>  
  select(file, line, topic1) 


```
